newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE court adjourns Filipino retrial session.
newsitem.headline: UAE court adjourns Filipino retrial session.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates' (UAE) supreme court adjourned on Saturday a retrial session in the case of a Filipino sentenced to death for murdering an Indian national, the Philippine embassy said.
"The court postponed the session in the case of John Aquino to February 1," an embassy official told Reuters.
The Federal Supreme Court in December overturned a criminal court ruling in the emirate of Ajman in 1989 sentencing Aquino to death.
Aquino was found guilty of stabbing Harbajan Singh to death and the attempted murder of another Indian man during an argument.
The Federal Supreme Court makes the final ruling on death sentences, but any execution must be approved by UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan.
